messages:
marta: FYI nightly perf job failed to attach nsys traces for the KV-cache sweep scenario. I can still see the CI job completed but artifacts are missing from s3.
chris: ugh, seen that before — usually a post-run uploader race. Which runner did this hit?
marta: runner-az-eu-6. The job log shows nsys finished and output a .qdrep, but the uploader logs have a 500 when hitting the artifact store. snippet: `ERROR: upload failed 500 InternalServerError`
perf-bot: automatically captured: `nsys --trace=nvtx,cuda --output=/tmp/run-1718723456 qla_app --workload=kv-sweep`
samir: is there a compressed artifact retention policy? qdrep files are huge. Maybe uploader timed out trying to stream a 2GB file.
teja: we had a similar case where kernel selection regressions only showed up in the long traces because short nightly runs used cached kernels. Suggest two things: 1) move nsys capture to the first failing step (no prefix cache), 2) slice traces into per-phase files so uploader can retry per-file.
marta: agree. Also we need an alert when a new nightly shows a >10% change in top-kernel time for the batching path. Right now diffs on the dashboard are manual.
chris: I can add an automated hotspot diff job: after perf artifacts land, run `nsys stats` -> extract top 5 CUDA kernels and create a small JSON summary. Upload the JSON to s3 + post to the perf diff dashboard. That way size is tiny and we get an early signal.
perf-bot: scheduled job created: `perf-summary-generator` triggers on artifact upload. Template command: `nsys stats -r /tmp/run-1718723456.qdrep --format csv > /tmp/summary.csv` then `python tools/parse_nsight_csv.py --in summary.csv --out summary.json`
samir: +1. Also we need a pruning policy for raw traces: keep last 14 days full qdrep for each job, keep summaries indefinitely. Do we gzip qdrep before upload? gzipping helps but may not reduce enough for nvprof outputs.
teja: propose: gzip + chunk (10MB) the qdrep and use multipart upload. Add retry with exponential backoff on 500s. For kernel-selection investigations we still need an uncorrupted single-file qdrep occasionally — add a weekly job that copies full qdrep to coldstore for one build per job.
marta: path forward: chris to prototype summary generator (small JSON of top kernels, CUDA time, kernel count); teja to update CI job to slice and gzip traces; samir to draft retention policy + coldstore cadence; I'll open a ticket to add a dashboard alert for top-kernel delta >10%.
chris: starting prototype now, will post a draft CLI and sample summary in this thread when ready.
ops-bot: notice: artifact-uploader retry window extended to 30m (was 5m) for runner-az-eu-6 as an emergency mitigation.
teja: one more note — make sure KV cache warmup isn't filtered by the tracer filter. We had artifacts where the first 50ms (kernel selection) were missing due to a `--trace-scope` mismatch. add a small unit test in the runner images that validates full-timeline capture.
marta: thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the ticket and link the dashboard once chris has the summary json prototype. :thumbsup:
